import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 998244353;
    static final int mod2 = 1000000007;
    static final int N = 1000010;
    static final int B = 1000000;
    static List<Integer>[] t = new ArrayList[7];
    static int[] s = new int[7];
    static int cnt = 0;
    static long n, x, y, ans;
    static BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
    static StringTokenizer st;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            t[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        int T = 1;
        // T can be read if needed
        while (T-- > 0) {
            solve();
        }
    }

    static void solve() throws IOException {
        n = qr();
        dfs(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(t[i]);
        }
        cnt = 0;
        ans = 0;
        dfs2(0, 0);
        ans = ((ans % mod2) + mod2) % mod2;
        pr2(ans);
    }

    static long qr() throws IOException {
        String line = br.readLine();
        st = new StringTokenizer(line);
        return Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
    }

    static int qrInt() throws IOException {
        String line = br.readLine();
        st = new StringTokenizer(line);
        return Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
    }

    static int val(int x) {
        if (x < 0) return x + mod;
        return x;
    }

    static void dfs(int x, long y) {
        cnt++;
        int z = val(cnt - (int) y);
        t[x].add(z);
        s[x] = (s[x] + z) % mod2;
        if (x == 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs(x + 1, y * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(int x, long y) {
        if (y > n) return;
        if (y * 10 * B > n && (y + 1) * B - 1 <= n) {
            long u = y;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                int w = val(cnt - (int) u);
                long size = t[i].size();
                ans += (long) w * size + s[i];
                int idx = lowerBound(t[i], mod - w);
                long count = t[i].size() - idx;
                ans -= count * (long) mod;
                u = (u * 10) % mod2;
            }
            ans %= mod2;
            cnt += 1111111;
            return;
        }
        if (x != 0) {
            cnt++;
            ans += val(cnt - (int) (y % mod));
        }
        for (int i = (x == 0 ? 0 : 0); i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs2(x + 1, y * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    static void pr2(long x) {
        System.out.println(x);
    }
}
